title: Adaptive Test-Time Compute Allocation via Learned Heuristics over Categorical Structure
paper_type_zh: 选择性验证与自适应测试时分配研究
best_for_zh: 优化结构化推理搜索中昂贵验证调用的读者。
one_line: The method saves verifier calls by gating invalid moves, ranking viable moves, and allocating a local verification budget at each reasoning state.
该方法通过筛除无效动作、排序可行动作并逐状态分配验证预算来节约验证调用。
why: It moves compute allocation from whole-problem sample counts to the ambiguous intermediate decisions where verification has the most marginal value.
inclusion_reason: It treats verifier calls as the scarce test-time resource and learns where intermediate reasoning states deserve them.

title: Problem
问题
html:
In structured reasoning search, the costly resource is often not generation tokens but verifier calls on intermediate moves. Uniformly checking every candidate wastes calls on malformed actions and clear choices, while solution-level best-of-N cannot direct verification toward the local branch where a single mistake will derail a long derivation.

The paper asks how to spend a finite verifier-call budget across intermediate states. It targets a setting where each move has explicit operator arguments and constraints, so cheap deterministic checks can remove obvious violations before an expensive process verifier decides semantic acceptability among the remaining candidates.

在结构化推理搜索中，昂贵资源往往不是生成 token，而是对中间动作的验证器调用。统一检查每个候选会把调用浪费在格式错误动作和明显选择上；而解答级最佳候选也无法把验证定向到某个局部关键分支，因为那里的一次错误可能毁掉整条长推导。

论文研究如何在中间状态之间分配有限的验证调用预算。它针对动作具有明确操作符、参数和约束的设置，使廉价的确定性检查能先去除明显违规，再由昂贵的过程验证器判断剩余候选的语义可接受性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central mechanism is gated competition. A deterministic structural gate rejects unparsable, out-of-scope, type-incompatible, or constraint-contradictory moves without a verifier call. Surviving moves receive a hybrid pre-verification score made of a structural distance-to-goal term and a learned residual trained to rank verifier-accepted moves above rejected ones within the same state.

The method then allocates a different top-k verification budget to each state. When survivor scores are close, the decision is locally uncertain and more candidates are verified; when they are separated, fewer calls are spent. The verifier still makes the accept/reject decision, so the learned score is a budget-prioritization device rather than an unverified substitute for correctness.

核心机制是门控竞争。确定性结构门会在不调用验证器的情况下拒绝无法解析、超出作用域、类型不兼容或与约束矛盾的动作。通过门的动作获得混合的验证前分数：它由到目标的结构距离和学习残差构成，后者在同一状态内训练为把验证器接受的动作排在拒绝动作之前。

方法随后为每个状态分配不同的前 k 个验证预算。当幸存动作分数接近时，局部决策不确定，便验证更多候选；分数分离时，则少花调用。验证器仍作出接受或拒绝决定，因此学习分数只是预算优先级工具，而非未经验证的正确性替代品。

title: Method
方法
html:
Exploration runs log post-gating candidate lists and a verifier label for every surviving move. A small MLP scores state, move, and goal embeddings; pairwise ranking loss trains accepted candidates ahead of rejected candidates, with an optional remaining-step auxiliary signal. At inference, the system generates or retrieves moves, applies structural and constraint gates, ranks survivors, chooses k from the score dispersion, verifies only that top-k set, and commits a verified move or retries/backtracks.

The controlled evaluation shares the same structured interface, generator, and PRM verifier across all methods. It uses Llama 3.2 1B as the default generator, MATH-500 with two-fold difficulty-bin cross-validation, and GSM8K for variation. Baselines are zero-shot CoT, 64-sample best-of-N, 64-sample majority vote, and beam search; verifier invocations are the primary cost measure rather than treating all tokens as equivalent.

探索运行记录通过门后的候选列表，以及每个幸存动作的验证器标签。一个小型 MLP 对状态、动作和目标嵌入打分；成对排序损失让接受动作排在拒绝动作之前，并可加入剩余步数辅助信号。推理时，系统生成或检索动作，应用结构和约束门，对幸存项排序，根据分数离散度选择 k，只验证前 k 个，并提交已验证动作或重试、回溯。

受控评测让所有方法共享同一结构接口、生成器和 PRM 验证器。它以 Llama 3.2 1B 为默认生成器，在 MATH-500 上做两折难度分箱交叉验证，并用 GSM8K 测试变化。基线为零样本思维链、64 样本最佳候选、64 样本多数投票和束搜索；验证器调用是主要成本度量，而不是把所有 token 当作同等成本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On MATH, the full method reaches 55.2% accuracy with 44.8 verifier calls on average. Beam search reaches 51.8% with 64 calls, while 64-sample best-of-N and majority vote reach 42.4% and 44.6%. Thus the reported comparison improves on the strongest listed baseline by 3.4 points while using 30% fewer verifier calls.

The ablation separates the claimed causes. Verifying all candidates without gates gives 45.0% at 64 calls; gates alone give 47.6% at 58 calls; adding structural scoring gives 51.8% at 54 calls; adding state-conditional allocation reaches 55.2% at 44.8 calls. This supports the paper’s specific claim that gating, ranking, and local uncertainty allocation contribute distinct efficiency gains.

在 MATH 上，完整方法以平均 44.8 次验证器调用达到 55.2% 准确率。束搜索以 64 次调用达到 51.8%，64 样本最佳候选和多数投票分别为 42.4% 与 44.6%。因此，报告中的比较以少 30% 的验证器调用，比列出的最强基线高 3.4 个百分点。

消融实验区分了主张的来源。不使用门而验证全部候选时，64 次调用得到 45.0%；仅用门时，58 次调用得到 47.6%；加入结构评分后，54 次调用得到 51.8%；加入逐状态分配后，44.8 次调用达到 55.2%。这支持论文的具体结论：门控、排序和局部不确定性分配分别带来效率收益。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier test-time allocation commonly chooses a rollout count per problem or uses a fixed search width. This work changes the allocation unit to an intermediate move and makes verifier calls, not merely samples, the explicit scarce resource. Its reusable record is a verifier-labeled candidate list tied to one structured state, from which a score and a local call budget are learned.

The contribution is not a more accurate verifier by itself. The verifier is held fixed across the principal comparison; the change is the gate–rank–allocate scaffold around it. Before reuse, inspect whether the target domain actually has a structured move interface, whether deterministic gates are sound enough to avoid rejecting useful moves, and whether score variance is calibrated as uncertainty rather than an artifact of the embedding model.

已有测试时分配通常为每个问题选择轨迹数量，或使用固定搜索宽度。本文把分配单位改为中间动作，并把验证器调用而非单纯样本设为明确稀缺资源。它的可复用记录是与一个结构化状态绑定的验证器标注候选列表，分数和局部调用预算都从中学习。

贡献并不只是更准确的验证器。主要比较中验证器保持固定；改变的是围绕它的门控—排序—分配支架。复用前应检查目标领域是否真有结构化动作接口、确定性门是否足够可靠而不会拒绝有用动作，以及分数方差是否校准为不确定性而非嵌入模型的伪影。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method cannot recover a correct path when the generator never proposes a feasible correct move, and its gates can only enforce constraints represented explicitly in the structured context. It therefore depends on the quality of the move language, candidate generator, PRM verifier, and uncertainty proxy. The empirical evidence is primarily mathematical structured reasoning with a call-dominated cost model; verifier latency, tool execution, unstructured natural-language steps, or correlated failures may alter the frontier. No official implementation is released, so exact serializers, gates, and exploration-log construction require independent reconstruction.
当生成器从未提出可行的正确动作时，该方法无法恢复正确路径；其门只能执行结构化上下文中被明确表示的约束。因此它依赖动作语言、候选生成器、PRM 验证器和不确定性代理的质量。实证证据主要是采用调用主导成本模型的数学结构化推理；验证延迟、工具执行、非结构化自然语言步骤或相关失败都可能改变前沿。没有官方实现发布，精确的序列化、门和探索日志构造需要独立重建。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when an agent or symbolic reasoner has expensive step verification and a machine-readable action interface. Start by logging every candidate state and verifier outcome, implement only high-precision deterministic gates, train a within-state ranker, and compare call-efficiency against verifying all survivors and a fixed-width search. The key reporting unit is not just pass rate: retain per-state candidates, gate decisions, selected top-k, verifier calls, and failures so that a lower call count can be audited rather than attributed to a hidden reduction in search coverage.
当智能体或符号推理器拥有昂贵步骤验证和机器可读动作接口时，可以使用这篇论文。先记录每个候选状态与验证器结果，只实现高精度确定性门，训练状态内排序器，并相对验证所有幸存项和固定宽度搜索比较调用效率。关键报告单位不只是通过率：应保留逐状态候选、门决策、选中的前 k 项、验证调用和失败，以便审计较低调用数，而不是把它归因于隐藏的搜索覆盖缩减。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember that this is a verifier-budget paper, not a generic prompt-time optimization method. The verifier remains the authority; learned scores merely decide who gets checked. The strongest evidence is the staged ablation from verify-all to gates, scoring, and state-k allocation. Its natural next test is a domain with executable intermediate actions, where gate precision and verifier false positives can be measured directly. Treat the reported 44% call reduction as a result under the paper’s structured interface and PRM protocol, not a portable percentage for arbitrary LLM evaluation.
要记住，这是验证器预算论文，而不是通用提示时优化方法。验证器仍是权威；学习分数只决定谁获得检查。最强证据是从验证全部候选到门、评分和状态 k 分配的逐步消融。其自然的下一项测试是带有可执行中间动作的领域，在那里可以直接测量门精度和验证器误报。把报告的 44% 调用减少理解为论文结构接口和 PRM 协议下的结果，而不是适用于任意 LLM 评测的可迁移百分比。
